description: Delphi — Colore: Ink & vintage white Collezione: Teatro Codice: 5023 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Medium Altezza: 135.5 cm Rapporto: 135.5 cm × 254 cm Toni: Black DELPHI takes its name from the ancient Greek city where Apollo's temple and theater stood — the same city whose bronze Charioteer inspired Mariano Fortuny and Henriette Negrin to create their iconic Delphos dress. The pattern is an extension of that lineage: structured, ceremonial, and defined by a classical precision that emphasizes form over ornament. Its flowing vertical lines evoke the pleated silk of the Delphos gown translated into a printed cotton surface — architectural, rhythmic, and quietly commanding. The large repeat supports wall applications and generous window treatments where the full composition can express itself at scale. Part of the TEATRO collection , printed on a cashmere-cotton ground.
